definitions.conversation_count: Distinct conversation_id with at least one turn.received event in period.
definitions.turn_count: Count of turn.received events in period.
definitions.active_user_count: Distinct actor_ref with at least one turn.received event in period.
definitions.issue_occurrence_count: Count of issue.extracted events in period.
definitions.knowledge_hit_rate: knowledge.answered / issue.extracted where route was KNOWLEDGE.
definitions.faq_hit_rate: faq.answered / issue.extracted where route was FAQ.
definitions.no_answer_count: answer.completed events with resultType NO_KNOWLEDGE or FAILED.
definitions.estimated_cost_usd: Sum of usage.recorded.estimatedCostUsd; missing usage is excluded from numerator and denominator coverage.
definitions.error_rate: request.failed count divided by turn count.
